CheckTitle: OBS bucket does not allow wildcard CORS origin
Description: **Huawei Cloud Object Storage Service (OBS)** buckets restrict **Cross-Origin Resource Sharing (CORS)** `AllowedOrigin` rules instead of allowing the wildcard `*`.
Risk: Allowing `*` as a **CORS** origin permits any third-party website to issue cross-origin requests to the OBS bucket from a user's browser, increasing the risk of **unauthorized data access** and cross-site data exfiltration.

Code.Other:
1. Log on to the **Huawei Cloud console**.
2. Navigate to **Object Storage Service (OBS)**.
3. Select the target **bucket**.
4. In the navigation pane, choose **Permissions** > **CORS Rules**.
5. Replace any `*` **Allowed Origin** entry with explicit trusted domain names.
6. Click **OK**.

Recommendation.Text: Configure explicit trusted origins in OBS bucket **CORS** rules instead of `*` following the principle of **least privilege**.
